lean.banner: Lean version — set up the Vibecode key in Administration to see everything

empty.period: No conversations for this period and filter. Try a longer period or another department.

performance.subtitle: {{from}} to {{to}} · arrows compare with the same number of days before
performance.lowSample_one: Few conversations in this selection ({{count}}). Treat the numbers as a hint.
performance.lowSample_other: Few conversations in this selection ({{count}}). Treat the numbers as a hint.

sla.title: Speed
sla.headline_one: {{count}} out of 10 customers answered within {{min}} min
sla.headline_other: {{count}} out of 10 customers answered within {{min}} min
sla.almostSame: Practically the same as the previous period ({{before}} → {{now}})
sla.tip: The {{min}} min are a dashboard reference, not a target set by the company. Conversations started by the team are not counted here. The faster a customer is answered on WhatsApp, the higher the chance of closing a deal. If it is not good: check in the hourly chart when the wait goes up and, in the team chart, who takes longest.

noAnswer.title: Nobody left unanswered
noAnswer.tip: A customer without an answer usually does not come back. If it is not good: the list with each customer and the CRM link is at the bottom of the page.

recontact.title: Solved the first time
recontact.headline_one: {{count}} time the customer reached out again within 2 days
recontact.headline_other: {{count}} times the customer reached out again within 2 days
recontact.none: No customer had to reach out again
recontact.tip: When the customer comes back right after, the problem was probably not solved in the first conversation. {{recurrent}} of {{clients}} customers reached out more than once in the period.

conversations.label: Conversations
conversations.desc: How many WhatsApp conversations happened in the period.

direction.label: Received · started
direction.desc: Who sent the first message: the customer (received) or the team (started).

contacts.label: Unique contacts
contacts.desc: How many different customers were served. Someone who reached out several times counts once.

firstAnswer.label: 1st answer
firstAnswer.desc: How long the customer usually waits for the first answer from a person (the bot does not count).
firstAnswer.bizOnly: Only time within business hours counts.

reply.label: Reply time
reply.desc: How long the team takes, on average, to answer each customer message throughout the conversation.

handling.label: Handling
handling.desc: How long a conversation usually stays open, from start until it is closed.

messages.label: Messages
messages.desc: Messages sent by the team and received from customers. Bot messages do not count.

return.label: Customer response
return.desc: Of the conversations the team started, how many the customer answered.

crm.label: In the CRM
crm.desc: How many conversations are linked to a contact, lead or deal in the CRM.

takeover.label: Time to take over
takeover.desc: How long it takes for a team member to take over the conversation. The bot may have answered before, but this only counts when someone from the team picks it up.

stuck.label: Forgotten conversations
stuck.desc: Conversations that stayed open for more than {{days}} days. A forgotten conversation leaves the customer without an answer and distorts the handling time.

won.label: Deals won
won.sub: {{total}} deals came from conversations ({{open}} in progress, {{lost}} lost)
won.desc: Won deals that came from conversations: linked directly to the conversation or created for the same customer up to {{days}} days later.

title.day: Conversations and response time per day
title.week: Conversations and response time per week
title.month: Conversations and response time per month

hourly.title: Conversations and response time by hour of day
hourly.worst: Longest wait at {{hour}}h ({{value}}): short of people at that time?

chart.note: Bars = conversations (left axis). Line = how long the customer usually waits (right axis); red dot = over {{ref}}, "+" = over {{cap}}.

people.title: Team: volume × speed
people.hint: Who handles the most and who takes longest to answer.
people.note: On the right: typical wait for the 1st answer (red = over {{value}}).

team.title: Team report
team.note: Hover over each column title to see what it measures. Click a person to filter the page. A conversation counts for whoever closed it; bot replies do not count.

conversations.label: Conversations
conversations.tip: Total conversations in the period. Below: how many the customer started (received) and how many the company started (started).

contacts.label: Unique contacts
contacts.tip: How many different customers the person served. A customer who reached out 3 times counts as 1.

messages.label: Messages
messages.tip: Messages the person sent / messages customers sent. Bot replies do not count.

firstAnswer.label: 1st answer
firstAnswer.tip: Average time between the customer's first message and the first answer from a person (not the bot).

reply.label: Reply time
reply.tip: Average time to answer during the whole conversation, not only the first time.

handling.label: Handling
handling.tip: Average time from the start to the end of the conversation.

noAnswer.label: No answer
noAnswer.tip: Conversations closed without any message from a team member.

return.label: Customer response
return.tip: Of the conversations the company started, how many the customer answered.

shift.label: Working hours
shift.tip: Time of the first and last message sent in the day. In the week/month view, it is the average of the days worked.

takeover.label: Took over in
takeover.tip: Average time until the person took over the conversation.

stuck.label: Forgotten
stuck.tip: Conversations that stayed open longer than the configured limit.

won.label: Deals won
won.tip: Won deals that came from the person's conversations, with the total amount.

stuck.title: Forgotten open conversations (more than {{days}} days)
stuck.empty: No conversation open for more than {{days}} days.
stuck.closedNote_one: In the period, {{count}} conversation stayed open longer than that before being closed.
stuck.closedNote_other: In the period, {{count}} conversations stayed open longer than that before being closed.

won.title: Deals won that came from conversations
won.empty: No won deal linked to the conversations in the period.
won.note: {{total}} deals came from conversations: {{open}} in progress and {{lost}} lost.

lost.title: Customers left without an answer
lost.empty: No customer was left without an answer.

details.waitTitle: How long the customer waited for the first answer
details.inside: During business hours ({{start}}h–{{end}}h) the typical wait is {{value}}.

settings.title: Dashboard settings
settings.refMinHint: Used in the Speed card and in the charts. It is not a target: just a yardstick to compare.
settings.bizOnly: Count wait time only within business hours
settings.bizOnlyHint: E.g.: a customer wrote at 10pm and was answered at 8am = 0 min of wait, not 10 h.
settings.dealWindow: A deal counts for the conversation if created up to
settings.dealWindowHint: Applies to deals of the same contact or lead. Deals linked directly to the conversation always count.

spam.label: Spam
spam.desc: Conversations flagged as spam in the period. They are left out of the other numbers.

abandon.label: Abandonment
abandon.desc: Of the closed conversations, how many were closed automatically for lack of interaction.

rating.label: Customer rating
rating.desc: Of the customers who rated the service, how many gave a positive rating.

reasons.title: Close reasons
reasons.empty: No closed conversations in the period.

channelSla.title: First-response goal per channel
channelSla.hint: Goal set on each channel, next to the panel reference ({{value}}).
channelSla.empty: No channel has a first-response goal configured.

full.keyRevoked: The key stopped working. Register a new one.
full.keyUnreadable: The stored key could not be read. Register it again.
